content: Shinniti
Tuˈmaˈ Yakubu, zheli ki Lya, nǝ mulban Yesu Almasihu, swamak gǝs kǝ kutl nǝ lopi ginǝ dlaˈga tǝn dǝp lǝɓa u. shinniˈ mulnalti.
Laˈti mbadli nǝ Shindǝtl ga
Yelsǝni ini, ǝn undiˈ bǝna kǝ shoti a mbi kini u aˈ pǝllin hwol tugi,
Kǝ manini cimbitl laˈti mbadlwakǝn u, nǝn ɗǝ zǝˈ ngashtibi.
Ikǝ ngashtibi nǝn njikǝˈ kyautǝn wasi, nǝn laˈti aˈ dǝm mul nalti nǝ ngaptiga, i laˈti bǝ kǝkǝn hwotl ullǝn wai.
In gonwakǝn a hwol maˈulǝn u, an ngyem Lya, mul bǝlti nǝ toh kǝ zoki , bǝnǝ laˈti biwai, Lya nǝn bǝtlti.
Amma an gyemi nǝ laˈti mbadli, bǝnǝ cetl mbadlwai, gaki mul cetl mbadli kǝnǝ lakumi kǝgeˈ balmal kǝn siɗa, ginǝ etǝl ɗǝ katti u, a ɗǝ jakǝnti
Bǝ undi mulu laˈmbadli tǝn mbiˈ ulǝn ama mulban wai.
Gaki timul mbatl lob kǝni, tiɗa zǝm mbatlwas nǝmmwai ageˈ lu mus kyautǝn waswai.
Ulkǝtoh nǝ Bǝna
Mul shindǝtl ga tǝppǝ ɓulmǝn nǝ nal twasi.
mul usǝn tǝmpǝtl ɓulmǝn nǝshindǝtl gawasi, ama tǝm paˈti kǝnǝ buzhame.
In cin a celga nǝ mattwasu, me nǝn kokǝnti, a buzhewas lwaki a mbuntwas gǝli. nǝgu tǝmul usǝn gǝli geˈ dlom kǝ tǝleti nǝ palliti wasi.
Bǝna nǝ Cibǝlti
Albalka tǝn mul ngacciˈ cimbǝtl bi, inta ngash bi geˈ cimbǝltu, tǝn mbiˈ ul kǝndǝ ga kǝ Gu kǝ mbidli, gunǝ mulban pǝli miˈ lyapti ndǝtu.
In ka mbi cimbil tu, bǝˈ usu “Lya kǝn ɗǝ cimbitl ki wai.” Gaki Lya ɗa cimbitl mulǝn nǝ bezǝn lǝɓa wai, kǝn pǝti a cimbǝlǝn Lya nǝ bezǝn wai;
Amma in mulǝn ambi gawas geˈ cimbiltu lawaskǝn shelti, a tle gawasi.
Bezǝn lyap lǝɓa in apǝl tugu, nǝnzǝˈ byas lǝɓa. in byas lǝɓa analu nǝn mbǝtl mǝshti.
Bǝs gǝl kini waica, mil yelsǝni ini mudli nǝ mwani.
Mus mbuni bǝlti ki njǝˈni, sul lya kǝn ɗǝ peˈti, mul mbǝˈsum maˈ Mulban kǝ cilti, gunǝ bǝ ɗa shottwai u kǝnǝ gwasǝn mul shaˈti.
Iˈ oli tǝp bǝlǝn min zǝti tuˈma shilǝn ki bali, gaki tǝn dǝmni kǝnǝ nyoh ki kina kǝ mus halitta wasi
Kub Shilǝn nǝ pǝlti
Mil yelsǝni ini mudli nǝ mwani, manǝngu: dleuwonkin ɗǝ gaˈti kǝm, bǝ dlewon kin ɗǝ shilǝn ko ɗǝ leutl mbadli wai,
gaki leukǝ mbatl ki yakǝn mbalǝn ɗa talaˈti ɗǝ pǝtl kyautǝn ki zoki ki Lya wai.
Gaki nǝgu, aˈ lakǝn mus kyautǝn ki bezǝn lǝɓa taka nǝ ngyem mbiti ki mbalǝn, shilǝn u nǝ dlilli geˈ mbadlwakǝn u, ndǝˈni nǝ nali geˈ shindǝtl ga, gaki tinǝ ndǝtl kǝ pekkǝtl dliwakǝn.
Dǝmni miˈ petl shilǝni, bǝmiˈ kumti katlwai, aki shatl gawakǝn wai.
gaki mus mulnǝ mul kup shilǝni katlu, bǝ mul pǝltiwai u, kǝnǝ mul nǝ ɗǝ yak kinawas age' boka u ni.
gaki tǝn yak kinawasi azzǝga, alǝbi alǝbi am musni nǝ tetwasi.
Amma mus mul nǝ ɗǝ yaˈ njikǝˈkǝ zhil ki mbiˈ ga u, inngash bi tǝnki u, tadǝm mul kumtikatl ammus niwai, addǝm mul pǝlti nǝ ɓotlti, gu sǝppǝliˈ albalka ageˈulnǝ ti pǝlti u.
In mulǝn ɗǝ patl gawasi ti mul bǝtl Lya kǝn u, amma bǝ ta ngab biwaswai u, iki bǝtl Lya wasu bali wai.

Bǝtl Lya ki zoki gunǝ bǝ bezǝn ulǝn ɗa giɓi wai u, akina ɗǝ Lya bwasinǝnˈ, iki kizi gulsi mudli, nǝˈ milu nǝ bǝ miˈ zǝssi ɗawai u, dwaɗǝn geˈ bǝna wasǝn u, aˈ pekkǝl gawaˈtaka ɗǝgeˈ bezǝn lǝɓa ki dǝp lǝɓa.
